desc: Mossy Oak Break-Up Country synthetic stock features textured gripping surface for a nonslip grip. Back-bored technology and Invector-Plus extra-full turkey choke tube produce dense and even shot patterns. Chrome-plated chamber and bore resist corrosion and wear. Truglo® fiber-optic front sight and adjustable rear sight gather light for accuracy in low-light conditions. Alloy receiver is drilled and tapped for scope bases. Rotary bolt with four sizable lugs provide strength and solid lockup. Inflex technology recoil pad directs recoil down and away from cheek. Black chrome protects bolts and components. Drop-out trigger makes cleaning easy. Crossbolt safety.
